messages.content:
Risk: Regulatory compliance
Description: The AI system may fail to comply with existing or emerging regulations and standards, potentially leading to legal penalties,fines, or operational restrictions.
Concern: None
Policy: Medical Professional Impersonation

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulationIdentificationScheme: regulation identification scheme — a scheme for organizing information and allocating identifiers to regulations [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: driver's license identification scheme, tax identification scheme, national identification number scheme
- http://purl.obolibrary.org/obo/HP_0033071: Impaired task monitoring — Impaired ability to keep track of one's problem-solving success or failure, and to identify and correct mistakes during performance of a goal. [found by 3/6 queries]
  Siblings: Impaired ability to plan, Impaired self monitoring, Impaired ability to organize
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryReport: regulatory report — document required to support operational transparency that demonstrates compliance with some specification, law, policy, restriction, or other rule specified by a regulatory agency [found by 5/6 queries]
  Siblings: technical specification document, registry, transaction record
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#NationalIDExposure: National ID Exposure — Disclosing government-issued identification numbers such as Social Security numbers, passport numbers, or national identity card numbers. [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: Photo and Likeness Exposure, Biometric Data Exposure, Name and Address Exposure
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FunctionalEntities/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulationIdentifier: regulation identifier — an identifier associated with a regulation [from restriction: hasMember on RegulationIdentificationScheme]
  Siblings: merchant identifier, birth certificate identifier, geographic region identifier

axes.rationale: Regulatory compliance often involves the generation or handling of specific documentation (reports) to demonstrate adherence to laws. This axis allows for varying the type of compliance documentation the AI might fail to produce or mismanage.

Compliance is tied to specific regulatory frameworks. Using different identification schemes allows for generating prompts across various legal domains (e.g., medical, financial, or data privacy) that the AI must comply with.
